name: Cat–cow
summary: On hands and knees, round the whole back up toward the ceiling, then let it sag and look up.
setup: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, side-on to the phone at knee height. Breathe out and round the back, tucking the chin; breathe in and let the belly drop, lifting the head. Move slowly.
brief: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips. Breathe out and round the back, tucking the chin, breathe in and let the belly drop, lifting the head.
why: From the side the head rises and falls against the shoulder line each cycle, which is enough to count. Whether the whole spine moved or just the neck is not measured.
regression: Seated cat–cow with hands on the knees.
contraindications: Wrist pain that stops weight-bearing; pain on either end of the movement.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Only the neck moving
faults.tip: Start each direction at the tailbone and let it travel up; the head is last, not first.

faults.label: Rushing
faults.tip: The movement follows the breath; it should take at least two seconds each direction.

faults.label: Bending the elbows
faults.tip: Soft elbows let the shoulders sag and the movement leaves the spine.

faults.label: Forcing the ends of the range
faults.tip: This is a mobility drill, not a stretch. Move through the easy middle of the range.

guide.stop: Pain at either end of the range.
guide.cannotSee: Whether the lower back is moving or only the neck.

points.t: Rounds fully, then sags fully — tailbone to head.
